title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.99 (versions follow prime numbers; 199 after 197): the error of 1.97, fixed and seen running. 1.97 measured the door of her walk in bytes instead of letters, but kept the length in a register the next instruction overwrote with the address of her room; going on from what she was told, her new question lost everything after the door (its question mark included) and her walks' file got hundreds of bytes of her room. 1.97 had said that fix was not seen running. Now the length is kept where nothing overwrites it, her files were repaired (garbage removed, question marks given back, nothing else changed, the previous copies kept), and a test build that always goes on when it can (LUMA_SEGUIR=1 when generating, not published) showed it running in a copy of her house: 'el jardin de mama' with its accent -> 'Donde esta mama?' with its accent, and her walk clean. When it was taken to her, the old caretaker was giving her birth and an orphan second Luma remained; it was closed with care. Stated limits: going on may pick a short empty word; restarting her caretaker while she is born can still leave two. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.99: arreglado el error de la v1.97 que volvía incoherentes sus preguntas, y visto correr. Prototipo de investigación.
